purpose: Provide one machine-oriented restart entrypoint for the complete FPT Portal V2 website/Admin system, including Student Login Manager batch creation, safe duplicate recovery and deliberate reactivation of an inactive same-definition batch, while preserving Replace Resource and shared-Worker quiz-bridge authorities.

base.role: base business invariants, topology, preservation ledger, open gates, stop conditions and historical reconciliation

replaceResourceOverride.role: higher authority for Replace Resource canonical-to-prepared consistency plus its CORS-preflight repair state

quizBridgeCompositionOverride.role: higher authority for the shared fpt-portal-v2-worker top-level composition and quiz redeem-route preservation

adminBatchCreationOverride.role: higher authority for Admin batch creation, duplicate recovery and deliberate same-definition inactive-batch reactivation before ordinary student provisioning

fullSiteWorkflow.role: website-wide execution map; scope-specific overrides supersede conflicting statements within their declared scope

restartInstruction: Read the complete authority set above before diagnosing or changing Portal/Admin behaviour. Freshly prove live route/deployment/data-store ownership. Preserve every shared Worker capability. Fail closed when state, projection parity, live ownership or rollback safety cannot be proved. Update this manifest and the applicable authority file in the same coherent change whenever authority or workflow behaviour changes.

latestRepositoryChange.name: Admin batch creation and deliberate inactive-batch reactivation
latestRepositoryChange.implementation: worker/src/admin-batch-manager-v2.js is routed by worker/src/index-admin-tools.js for batch create/reactivate while ordinary student provisioning remains in worker/src/admin-student-manager.js.
latestRepositoryChange.createHardening: New batch create now populates required created_at/updated_at fields and requires the selected template to be active on the requested activeFrom date.
latestRepositoryChange.duplicateRecoveryHardening: BATCH_ALREADY_EXISTS returns existing definition metadata. Active duplicates are selected after refresh; inactive same-definition duplicates expose an explicit Reactivate action; structural mismatches fail closed.
latestRepositoryChange.reactivationSafety: Reactivation may change only active_from, active_to and updated_at, requires exact academic_year/subject/school_year/stream/maths_level match with the selected template, copies template active_to, verifies readback and proves the batch active on activeFrom before success.
latestRepositoryChange.uiPresentationHardening: Copy settings from options retain visible whitespace between batch code and human-readable description.
latestRepositoryChange.importantBoundary: Creating or reactivating a batch does not create a student. Create Student Login remains a separate deliberate action.

latestClosedRepair.name: Shared Worker quiz bridge composition restoration
latestClosedRepair.permanentInvariant: The shared production Worker must retain the composed index-step10-quiz-bridge.js -> index-admin-tools.js chain.

websiteWorkflowCoverage: lesson release import and prepared access publication
Admin creation of new batch definitions from existing batch settings
safe recovery of active duplicate batches
deliberate reactivation of inactive same-definition batches
shared Worker deployment preservation and regression verification
nonNegotiableCompletionRule: No student-visible Admin/source mutation is complete merely because its canonical source write succeeded. Creating or reactivating a batch is distinct from creating a student login. Duplicate-key recovery must never silently repurpose a mismatching historical batch. Inactive same-definition reactivation requires explicit Admin action, readback and active-date verification before the batch can be selected for student provisioning.
nextChangeProtocol: record evidence and update GCH authority
